text: Residents in East Harrow learned Thursday that Peregrine Lens has acquired Fennimore Optics, ending the family-owned maker’s 38-year run as an independent company. At a brief announcement outside Fennimore’s workshop on Alder Quay, Peregrine spokesman Dalen Voss said the deal closed Wednesday evening for an undisclosed sum. I was told the purchase includes Fennimore’s downtown service counter and its 14 employees, all of whom will remain on payroll through the spring. Shop manager Elise Marr told me she had already met with the new owners and expected “no immediate changes” to repairs or pricing. By late afternoon, workers were still boxing up records, while customers continued to drop off broken lenses as usual.
